name: Lebanese Pan-Fried Veggie Ground Pitas (Arayes) with Lemon-Tahini Yogurt Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and place leaves in a food processor.

Peel, halve, and roughly chop onion; peel garlic. Add both to the food processor. Pulse on high, scraping down the sides of the processor as needed, until veggies are puréed and paste-like in consistency, 30-60 seconds.

Transfer purée to a strainer and gently press on the solids with the back of a spoon to remove excess liquid (discard liquid). Place purée in a medium bowl along with veggie ground, pomegranate molasses (or balsamic glaze), and spices. Using your hands, mix until well combined.
instructions.secondary_message:
454 g veggie ground, plant based
2 tbsp balsamic glaze
1 tsp sumac, ground
½ tsp cumin, ground
½ tsp coriander, ground
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp allspice, ground
¼ tsp cinnamon, ground
¼ tsp nutmeg, ground

instructions.primary_message: Cut pitas in half and carefully open the pockets. Using a rounded ¼-cup measure, add meat filling to each pita half and spread evenly to fill the inside. Gently press the sides together to seal and place on a plate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add 1 tbsp oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add 2 filled pitas and cook, undisturbed, until golden underneath, about 5 minutes; flip pitas, and cook an additional 5 minutes, until cooked through. Transfer arayes to a platter. Repeat three times more with remaining oil and pitas.
instructions.secondary_message: ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and juice lemon into a small bowl. Add yogurt, tahini, water, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the lemon-tahini sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lemon
½ cup plain Greek yogurt
2 tbsp tahini
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Serve arayes with lemon-tahini sauce for dipping and enjoy!
